description: This file defines a 'ProductCard' UI component for a shopping application, responsible for displaying product details and handling interactions such as adding to cart.

classes.name: ProductCard
classes.description: A Lightning JS component representing a product card with UI elements for product details and add-to-cart controls.

methods.name: $increment
methods.description: Increases the product quantity up to the maximum stock.

methods.name: $decrement
methods.description: Decreases the product quantity down to a minimum of 1.

methods.name: $addToCart
methods.description: Adds the current product with specified quantity to the shopping cart.
